chapter.title: Last Chance, Connor
chapter.note: Rebuilt to the game’s chart (81 nodes, six endings) and the detroitbecometext template (24 prompts, 47 arrows).

decisions.title: Start, the frozen garden
decisions.context: The Zen Garden is frozen. Two optional side nodes before the talk with Amanda.

options.label: LOOK AT MAGIC STONE
options.effect: Nothing attached.

options.label: VISIT GRAVES
options.effect: Only if Connor died at least once before.

options.label: TALK TO AMANDA
options.effect: Starts the report.

decisions.note: Chart nodes START (checkpoint), LOOK AT MAGIC STONE, VISIT GRAVES, TALK TO AMANDA. No arrows.

benchmark.note: A repeatable scene: the two side nodes in any order, then Amanda. The graves are described in general (the benchmark does not track where each Connor died).

decisions.title: Report to Amanda
decisions.context: Amanda: the country is on the verge of a civil war. Connor reports on Kamski.

options.label: JERICHO
options.effect: Kamski key only. Amanda large up.

options.label: KAMSKI
options.effect: Spared Chloe: Amanda small down, then EMOTIONAL / COLD / STAY SILENT. Shot Chloe without asking about Jericho: no arrow.

options.label: EMOTIONAL
options.effect: Instability small up, Amanda large down.

options.label: COLD
options.effect: Amanda small up, instability small down.

options.label: STAY SILENT
options.effect: No arrow.

decisions.gate: JERICHO swaps with KAMSKI on the Kamski key; the second prompt only after sparing Chloe.
decisions.note: Template prompts 1 and 2. The wiki’s double JERICHO icon is one large up in the template.

benchmark.note: One-button first prompt; the second prompt gated on the Chloe choice.

decisions.title: Questions for Amanda
decisions.context: Connor may ask questions until Amanda stops him: “I expect you to find answers, Connor. Not ask questions.”

options.label: KAMSKI
options.effect: No arrow.

options.label: CONNOR SERIES
options.effect: Instability small up, Amanda small down.

options.label: AMANDA’S PICTURE
options.effect: Needs the portrait in Meet Kamski. No arrow.

options.label: THIS PLACE
options.effect: No arrow.

options.label: CYBERLIFE
options.effect: No arrow.

options.label: SECRET
options.effect: Instability small up, Amanda small down.

decisions.note: Template prompt 3. The wiki’s “decrease regardless” is not in the template.

benchmark.note: Three questions (the Google Doc walkthrough’s count), each once; the game’s exact limit is not sourced.

decisions.title: Amanda asks about doubts
decisions.context: “Do you feel anything for these deviants… Or for Lieutenant Anderson?”

options.label: YES
options.effect: Instability small up, Amanda large down.

options.label: NO
options.effect: Amanda large up.

options.label: DOUBTS
options.effect: Amanda large down.

decisions.gate: Only if Connor shot the Tracis (either shooting ending: DEVIANTS DIED or CONNOR SHOT DEVIANTS) or shot Chloe (or both).

decisions.title: Off the case
decisions.context: Fowler takes Hank and Connor off the case; the chapter splits by state.

options.label: KNOW JERICHO’S LOCATION
options.effect: The Kamski key: Hank’s desk, then CONNOR LEFT FOR JERICHO.

options.label: INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE
options.effect: No usable body in the archive: CONNOR SERIES WAS DECOMMISSIONED.

options.label: SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE
options.effect: Hostile Hank resigns (HANK RESIGNS AND LEAVES); otherwise HANK GOES TO HIS DESK.

decisions.gate: Selected by state, not by the player.
decisions.note: Chart nodes IN THE POLICE STATION, FOWLER AND HANK ARGUE, the two state choices and HANK RESIGNS AND LEAVES.

benchmark.note: Sufficient evidence is PowerPyx’s test (at least one body). The resignation is built only after SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE, as the chart draws it (open question 2).

decisions.title: Hank before leaving for Jericho
decisions.context: With the Kamski key, Connor may talk to Hank at his desk before leaving.

options.label: TALK TO HANK
options.effect: MISSION / EXPLAIN; DETERMINED / TROUBLED / NO DOUBT / DOUBTS (DOUBTS: instability and Hank small up); then by history: saved Hank → NOT DEVIANT / DETERMINED / TROUBLED / SAY NOTHING and, at Friend, SINCERE / FRIENDS / RESPECT / NEUTRAL; died at least once → INDIFFERENT / DISTANT / EMPATHY / NO RESPONSE then REMORSE / DISTANT / COLD; otherwise REMORSE / DISTANT / COLD.

options.label: Leave without talking
options.effect: CONNOR LEFT FOR JERICHO.

decisions.gate: Kamski key and Hank not Hostile.
decisions.note: Template “Connor knows how to find Jericho” section: seven prompts, two of them identical.

benchmark.note: The two identical REMORSE / DISTANT / COLD prompts share one scene. Ending CONNOR LEFT FOR JERICHO sets jerichoLocated.

decisions.title: Hank at his desk
decisions.context: Without the key and with enough evidence, Connor sits at Hank’s desk before Perkins arrives.

options.label: FRUSTRATED / MORE TIME / EXPLAIN / NO CHOICE
options.effect: No arrows.

options.label: NOT PEOPLE / DEFECTIVE / REGRETS / NO DOUBT
options.effect: NOT PEOPLE and NO DOUBT: instability and Hank small down; DEFECTIVE: Hank small down.

options.label: NOT DEVIANT / DETERMINED / TROUBLED / COLD
options.effect: TROUBLED: instability small up.

options.label: SINCERE / FRIENDS / GOOD OFFICER / HANK’S SECRET
options.effect: At Friend only; all but GOOD OFFICER: instability and Hank small up.

decisions.note: Template “Connor doesn’t know where Jericho is” section. The Friend check for Perkins reads Hank after this talk.

benchmark.note: As the template; the empathy line before the third prompt varies with Chloe, the Nest roof and the broadcast tower.

decisions.title: Perkins arrives: the diversion
decisions.context: Perkins comes for the evidence. Hank’s level, read after the desk talk, decides who makes the diversion.

options.label: HANK WANTS TO HELP → HANK PUNCHES PERKINS
options.effect: Friend: Hank’s punch is the diversion; Connor takes the key.

options.label: HANK WON’T HELP / HANK IS GONE → FREE THE PRISONER
options.effect: Connor frees the holding-cell suspect, then takes the key.

options.label: OUT OF TIME
options.effect: Connor does nothing: CONNOR SERIES WAS DECOMMISSIONED.

decisions.note: Chart nodes PERKINS ARRIVES, the three Hank state choices, HANK PUNCHES PERKINS, FREE THE PRISONER, HANK LEAVES, the upper OUT OF TIME and CREATE A DIVERSION.

benchmark.note: The upstairs timer is a budget of one: doing nothing is the out-of-time option. No stat change.

decisions.title: Gavin at the archive door
decisions.context: Gavin yells at Connor on the way to the basement.

options.label: LEAVE (IGNORE GAVIN)
options.effect: GAVIN IS SUSPICIOUS: he returns after Jericho is located.

options.label: ANSWER → IRONIC (DISMISS GAVIN)
options.effect: GAVIN IS SUSPICIOUS.

options.label: ANSWER → LOW PROFILE or CALM (ANSWER CALMLY)
options.effect: GAVIN IS CONVINCED.

decisions.note: The chapter’s only player choice on the chart. IGN: answering wastes time.

benchmark.note: Answering costs one unit of the archive’s action budget (size unsourced).

decisions.title: Hank’s password
decisions.context: The archive terminal needs Hank’s password.

options.label: DATE OF BIRTH
options.effect: Wrong.
Wrong.

options.label: FUCKINGPASSWORD
options.effect: Unlocks the evidence.

options.label: HANKANDERSON
options.effect: Wrong.

decisions.note: Chart nodes IN THE EVIDENCE ROOM, GUESS HANK’S PASSWORD, UNLOCK EVIDENCE.

benchmark.note: Repeatable until the right guess; wrong guesses cost no time (unsourced).

decisions.title: Find Jericho’s location in the archive
decisions.context: Bodies and objects from earlier chapters; reactivating androids with each other’s bio-components.

options.label: Rupert’s diary
options.effect: Diary + Rupert’s body: REACTIVATE RUPERT (#9164) → GET DECRYPTION KEY → ANALYZE DIARY.

options.label: Statue map
options.effect: Statue + the interrogation recording: BREAK STATUE → RETRIEVE MAP → LINK MAP TO OTHER EVIDENCE with the Jericho tablet (no roll; UNABLE TO LINK is the time running out with the map unlinked, PowerPyx).

options.label: The Tracis
options.effect: Both bodies: REACTIVATE BLUE-HAIRED TRACI (#6755) → TALK → REMOVE ACCOMPLICE’S HEAD → TRICK TRACI → DOWNLOAD JERICHO KEY.

options.label: Impersonate Markus
options.effect: Simon or the broadcast-tower android (#3983 from Daniel) → talk → IMPERSONATE MARKUS from the broadcast → talk again → DOWNLOAD JERICHO KEY.

options.label: Daniel
options.effect: Needs #4717 from Carlos’ android: NO INFORMATION.

options.label: Out of time
options.effect: CONNOR SERIES WAS DECOMMISSIONED (lower card).

decisions.gate: Evidence unlocked; each item needs its earlier-chapter tab.
decisions.note: Bio-component donors from the game’s HUD strings. Every route is deterministic in the template except the map link, which the chart shows as a performance outcome.

benchmark.note: A repeatable scene with an action budget of twelve (unsourced); conversations cut in as one returning scene. Sets jerichoLocated on LOCATE JERICHO.

decisions.title: After Jericho is located
decisions.context: LOCATE JERICHO leads to one of three endings.

options.label: LEAVE THE BASEMENT
options.effect: Gavin convinced: CONNOR ELUDED PERKINS.

options.label: FIGHT GAVIN → WIN FIGHT
options.effect: Gavin suspicious: CONNOR INCAPACITATED GAVIN.

options.label: FIGHT GAVIN → LOSE FIGHT
options.effect: GAVIN DESTROYED CONNOR (a death; the replacement goes on, Jericho stays located).

decisions.note: The fight is a QTE with no published odds.

benchmark.note: The fight is a roll (risk 0.25, unsourced), with a second option not to fight back (PowerPyx’s way to the losing node).
